layers.name: basic kinematics
layers.evidence: Both real windows and both candidate runs carry full state, kinematic and quality statistics with independently reproduced denominators. FC1 sim 22.29 vs real 10.51; FC2 sim 20.35 vs real 7.915. FC1 sim 20.53 vs real 43.54; FC2 sim 19.81 vs real 50.51. FC1 sim 0.00047471 vs real 0.096892; FC2 sim 0.0421 vs real 0.25297.
layers.necessary_metric_status: Comparable under the frozen common semantics; no approved margin exists
layers.blocking: Without an independent measurement-error bound and an approved delta no pass may be recorded for any kinematic statistic.

layers.name: following and physical interaction
layers.evidence: net_gap = getLeader distance + follower minGap with the prior 0.0 m same-lane cross-check; closing = follower - leader; the exact step-displacement chain is retained: FC1 exact 381560/381560, bounded 36, not-evaluable 1511, blockers 0, max residual 2.84e-14 m against 1e-6 m; FC2 exact 355458/355458, bounded 86, not-evaluable 1318, blockers 0, max residual 2.84e-14 m against 1e-6 m. FC1 sim 2.73 vs real -0.1714; FC2 sim 3.67 vs real -0.1094. FC1 sim 41.19 vs real 18.81; FC2 sim 41.39 vs real 15.38.
layers.necessary_metric_status: Distributions and gap/closing means produced on both sides; no approved margin
layers.blocking: Simulated closing-speed means are positive while both real windows are negative, so the interaction regime differs in sign, not only magnitude.

layers.name: target state support, valid sample and precision
layers.evidence: Every pre-declared 30 s block envelope excludes its own target: FC1 blocks v[19.425,25.942] k[17.921,23.186] vs target v=10.51 k=43.54; FC2 blocks v[16.990,25.195] k[16.269,23.289] vs target v=7.915 k=50.51. The observed internal cross-section flow is reproduced (FC1 sim 1647.4 vs real 1646.9 veh/h/lane; FC2 sim 1451.4 vs real 1439.2 veh/h/lane) but on the free-flow branch, not the observed congested branch. One simulator trajectory per condition and no independent-seed repeat executed; local exposure FC1 1458.1 veh-s; FC2 1408.4 veh-s against real interior 31051.6 and 33091.1.
